At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
Reimagine What’s Possible
Rotoflow, an Air Products Business, is a full-service turbomachinery OEM providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and aftermarket services to customers globally in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Aftermarket services include spare parts, repairs, upgrades, field services, engineering evaluations, reliability and performance assessments, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, and shop services from regional service centers for both Air Products and non-Air Products equipment.
We are seeking an Aftermarket Machinery Engineer at our turbomachinery service center in Houston, Texas, responsible for providing engineering support for spares, repairs, upgrades, reverse engineering, and field service of all types of turbomachinery. We will also consider the alternative work location of our new equipment manufacturing site in Bethlehem, PA.
What's In It For You
At Air Products, we foster a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard, and everyone feels they belong and matter. Additionally, we offer competitive pay and great benefits for our employees. Check out some of our benefits below!

  • Affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (day 1 of employment)
  • 401k with 100% vested company core and match
  • Paid Vacation, holidays, and sick time
  • Paid Parental leave (Up to 8 weeks)
  • Backup Child and Adult Care benefits
  • Adoption assistance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (medical and dependent daycare)
  • Life Insurance (AD&D - paid for by Air Products), Supplemental AD&D
  • Legal Plan & Identity Theft coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Many more supplemental benefits available
Key Job Responsibilities
  • Support machinery refurbishment, upgrades, and rerate activities by developing technical scope for service activity in both field and service centers, including detailed design engineering of mechanical and aerodynamic systems.
  • Develop, update, and implement procedures and processes for servicing various turbomachinery products, including other OEM equipment.
  • Perform reverse engineering of turbomachinery components to **build** replacement part engineering and manufacturing drawings.
  • Participate in Root Cause Analyses and develop technical reports for customers.
  • Act as a primary technical point of contact to internal and external customers, including fixing requests.
  • Provide on-site support as vital, with an average travel expectation of 25%, subject to change based on planned/unplanned activities.
  • Support proposal development by reviewing technical scope and cost for repairs and field services.
  • Work closely with senior product engineers for effective knowledge transfer.
  • Provide feedback on staffing and resources to ensure customer needs are met.
  • Ensure individuals supporting field activities are trained and qualified, **crafting** training programs as needed.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to improve reliability and customer value.
  • Develop engineering capabilities for the aftermarket service business, including RCA, FEA, CFD, rotordynamics, and redesigns.
Minimum Hiring Requirements
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience with repair disposition of turbomachinery or related technologies.
  • Hands-on knowledge of turbomachinery, accessory systems, and related technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs).
  • Knowledge of equipment assembly, operation, and maintenance.
  • Familiarity with machinery commissioning, resolving, and servicing practices.
  • Understanding of control systems and instrumentation for commissioning and fixing.
  • Knowledge of ASME, ASTM, API, and other relevant codes.
  • Experience with SAP ERP systems.
  • Proficiency with drafting and modeling applications such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Effective communication, documentation, and technical writing skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, adapt to changing priorities, and raise awareness of resource gaps.
Highly Valued
  • 10+ years of experience with turbomachinery or related technologies.
  • Detailed engineering experience with Rotoflow or similar OEM equipment.
  • Knowledge of design for manufacturability and GD&T.
  • Experience with reverse engineering techniques.
  • Skills in aerodynamic design of components, gas dynamics, CFD, and FEA of centrifugal impellers.
  • Familiarity with various bearing types (oil, gas, magnetic, etc.) and fixing rotor-bearing systems.
  • Experience with dry gas seals and controls systems for PLC/DCS.
  • Expertise in crafting mechanical and aerodynamic components for upgrades and rerates.
  • Familiarity with tooling design and proven understanding of SolidWorks/3D modeling.

As a Veteran-friendly organization, we actively encourage and welcome Veterans to apply for various roles within our company. Join to apply for the Senior Engineering Manager- Ubuntu role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager to lead the engineering team that delivers the essential components of Ubuntu - our system startup, compilers, language runtimes and toolchains, as well as networking and storage config and management. This is a fast-paced, problem-solving, highly technical role operating at the core of Linux server systems.
As an Engineering Manager on the Foundations team, you will be at the heart of driving Ubuntu. Working at the unique intersection of the open source ecosystem, and enterprise technologists.
In this pivotal position, you'll lead and inspire your team of engineers, to take Ubuntu to new heights. We are looking for someone with a deep understanding of Linux and Ubuntu with a passion for exceptional leadership. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery and drive your team on strategy and execution.
Location: Globally remote
The role entails

  • Lead and grow a team of distributed engineers
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles through active and hands on leadership
  • Be responsible for planning, estimation and execution
  • Work with product management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leadership teams
  • Drive the advancement and adoption of the latest software development practices
  • Design, embrace and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with company values
  • Engage with other teams at Canonical to ensure alignment on product architecture and roadmaps
  • Work from home while meeting in person for company sprints. Sprints are typically twice a year for 1-2 weeks.
What we are looking for in you
  • You have worked extensively with Linux distributions, and are experienced with packaging technologies (e.g. deb, rpm, other)
  • You have demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • High quality software engineering knowledge in one or more of: Linux system architecture, boot process, Java/GCC/Python/Rust/Go toolchains, ARM and/or RISC-V
  • Engagement with open source communities and processes
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Key responsibilities/Expectations from the Role

  • Lead the end-to-end migration from Citrix ADC to F5 BIG-IP, ensuring a smooth and efficient process.
  • Collaborate with the Engineering team to develop migration strategies and incorporate their recommendations into the project.
  • Assess existing Citrix ADC configurations, including load balancing, SSL offloading, authentication, and security policies.
  • Design and implement F5 BIG-IP architectures that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Configure and test F5 BIG-IP features such as LTM, SSL/TLS profiles, persistence, iRules, and high availability.
  • Perform traffic cutover to F5 BIG-IP in a phased manner to minimize service disruptions.
  • Conduct functional and performance testing to validate migration success and address any issues.
  • Optimize F5 BIG-IP configurations for performance, security, and reliability.
  • Document new F5 BIG-IP configurations and provide training to the Operations and Support teams.
  • Offer post-migration support and address any issues identified during the transition phase.
  • Monitor and log network traffic to ensure proactive issue identification and resolution.

Must Have

  • Strong experience with Citrix ADC (NetScaler) and F5 BIG-IP (LTM).
  • Deep knowledge of load balancing, SSL/TLS offloading, session persistence, and traffic management.
  • Experience in high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations.
  • Familiarity with security features such as WAF, access control policies, and authentication mechanisms.
  • Proficiency in writing and troubleshooting F5 iRules.
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good to Have

  • Ability to work closely with Engineering and Operations teams to align project strategies and incorporate feedback.
  • Excellent documentation and reporting skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Awareness of security best practices in automation and the ability to implement secure coding principles.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • F5 Certified Administrator (F5-CA) or F5 Certified Technical Specialist (F5-CTS) preferred.
  • Citrix certifications such as CCP-N (Citrix Certified Professional – Networking) are a plus.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in network engineering, with significant experience in Citrix ADC and F5 BIG-IP migration or administration.
  • Experience in enterprise-level network environments and large-scale migrations.

title: Cloud Architect
description:
A Spesia, a mais nova empresa do Grupo Med4U, nasce para simbolizar nossa busca incessante por soluções inovadoras e disruptivas, utilizando inteligência artificial para oferecer tratamentos mais precisos, humanos e transformadores. Inspirada na palavra latina spes (esperança) e no IA de Inteligência Artificial, a Spesia reflete nosso compromisso com cuidados humanizados e centrados no paciente.

Nossa missão vai além da tecnologia: buscamos melhorar os desfechos clínicos, promovendo esperança e colocando o paciente no centro de tudo o que fazemos. Com a Spesia, queremos redefinir o cuidado em saúde, ajudando a construir vidas mais longas, saudáveis e plenas.

Junte-se a nós para transformar a saúde e fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Saiba mais sobre o Grupo Med4U em

Sobre o Projeto:

Este projeto é focado na construção de modelos de machine learning e processamento de linguagem natural para a predições no contexto da saúde e a análise avançada de dados clínicos. Utilizando dados de prontuários eletrônicos (EHR), exames laboratoriais e dados biomedicos, o objetivo é desenvolver soluções inovadoras para apoiar a prevenção, diagnóstico e tratamento de câncer, integrando diferentes fontes de dados biomédicos e aplicando metodologias estatísticas robustas.

Buscamos um(a) Cloud Architect com forte atuação hands-on para ser responsável pela arquitetura, implementação e operação de nossa infraestrutura em nuvem, com foco em soluções de dados, machine learning e aplicações. Este profissional terá um papel central no desenho de soluções escaláveis, seguras e eficientes, além de atuar como apoio técnico para os times de engenharia de dados, ciência de dados e desenvolvimento de produtos.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura em nuvem (GCP) para suportar aplicações, pipelines de dados e modelos de machine learning.
  • Criar, manter e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions ou similares) para aplicações, pipelines de dados e modelos.
  • Automatizar provisionamento de infraestrutura (Infrastructure as Code) utilizando Terraform.
  • Definir padrões de arquitetura, governança, segurança, observabilidade e escalabilidade em nuvem.
  • Criar e gerenciar ambientes de produção, staging e desenvolvimento na GCP.
  • Monitorar performance, disponibilidade, segurança e custos dos serviços em nuvem, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Apoiar e colaborar ativamente com os times de engenharia de dados, MLOps, produto e ciência de dados.
  • Gerenciar e evoluir pipelines de dados, ambientes de analytics e infraestrutura para MLOps.
  • Promover cultura de automação, segurança e boas práticas DevSecOps.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Cloud Architect com foco em GCP.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em arquitetura de nuvem (compute, storage, networking, IAM, segurança, monitoramento).
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform).
  • Experiência com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, GKE).
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build ou similares).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em sistemas Linux, redes, segurança e governança em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente com engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e desenvolvedores.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de dados (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mesh, pipelines ELT).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de microserviços e event-driven (Kafka, Pub/Sub ou similares).
  • Experiência com soluções serverless e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Experiência com monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, etc.).
  • Conhecimentos em práticas de FinOps (otimização de custos em nuvem).

Salário compatível com o mercado.

Oportunidade de participar de um projeto inovador e ambicioso com impacto direto na saúde e bem-estar dos pacientes.

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - MLOps & Analytics role at Canonical

The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical
As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.
You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.
You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.
We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.
Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.
Location: This is a Globally remote role.
What your day will look like

  • Manage a distributed team of engineers and its MLOps/Analytics portfolio
  • Organize and lead the team's processes in order to help it achieve its objectives
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Interact with a vibrant community
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions
  • Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery
  • Professional python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source
  • A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve
  • Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Additional skills that you might also bring
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with building machine learning models
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Experience in the Linux and open-source software world
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on a distributed team on an open source project -- even if that is community open source contributions.
  • Demonstrated track record of Open Source contributions
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Você será responsável por guiar e apoiar uma equipe de desenvolvedores, garantindo a entrega de soluções de software de alta qualidade em um ambiente SaaS dinâmico. Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, liderança e inovação, e possui experiência comprovada no ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software, queremos conhecê-lo(a)!

Responsabilidades

  1. Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver uma equipe de desenvolvedores de software, promovendo um ambiente de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo e alta performance;
  2. Atuar como ponto focal técnico para a equipe, auxiliando na resolução de problemas complexos e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas de desenvolvimento;
  3. Colaborar de perto com Product Owners e Product Managers para traduzir requisitos de negócio em especificações técnicas claras e implementáveis;
  4. Garantir a qualidade e a escalabilidade das soluções entregues, supervisionando ativamente revisões de código, definições de arquitetura e testes;
  5. Monitorar o progresso dos projetos, identificar riscos e propor planos de mitigação, garantindo a entrega dentro dos prazos e orçamentos estabelecidos;
  6. Promover a inovação e a adoção de novas tecnologias e metodologias que possam aprimorar os processos de desenvolvimento e a qualidade dos nossos produtos SaaS;
  7. Conduzir avaliações de desempenho da equipe, fornecer feedback construtivo e auxiliar no plano de carreira dos membros do time;
  8. Assegurar a documentação adequada de projetos, processos e componentes de software. Realizar a gestão orçamentária da área, monitorando os custos de pessoas, ferramentas e infraestrutura de acordo com o planejamento da empresa.

Requisitos

  1. Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software, com foco em aplicações SaaS;
  2. Experiência prévia em liderança de equipes de desenvolvimento ou coordenação de projetos técnicos;
  3. Forte conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  4. Proficiência em linguagens de programação relevantes para o nosso stack (Java SpringBoot, React, Python, RabbitMQ, Redis);
  5. Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL (ex: PostgreSQL e MongoDB);
  6. Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e APIs RESTful;
  7. Experiência com serviços de nuvem (preferencialmente Azure) e práticas de DevOps/CI/CD;
  8. Habilidade para se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com equipes técnicas e não técnicas;

  10. Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada.

Diferenciais

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - MLOps & Analytics role at Canonical

The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical
As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.
You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.
You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.
We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.
Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.
Location: This is a Globally remote role.
What your day will look like

  • Manage a distributed team of engineers and its MLOps/Analytics portfolio
  • Organize and lead the team's processes in order to help it achieve its objectives
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Interact with a vibrant community
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions
  • Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery
  • Professional python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source
  • A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve
  • Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Additional skills that you might also bring
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with building machine learning models
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Experience in the Linux and open-source software world
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on a distributed team on an open source project -- even if that is community open source contributions.
  • Demonstrated track record of Open Source contributions
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Coordenador de Planejamento Comercial, Mass Vendor Relations
description:
Job ID: 2892165 | Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda.

Esta é uma posição de colaborador individual.

A Amazon está procurando uma pessoa Coordenadora de Planejamento Comercial para se juntar à nossa equipe de Mass Vendor Relations (MVR) no Brasil. Ela será responsável por apoiar e executar o planejamento de demanda para maximizar a disponibilidade de produtos, margens e giro de estoque com processos altamente escaláveis para milhares de fornecedores. Esta pessoa terá a responsabilidade de garantir que os sistemas e processos de inventário atendam às necessidades do negócio e implementar controles relacionados. Além disso, ela também irá permear por um ambiente de alta complexidade onde atividades táticas e estratégicas devem ser conduzidas em paralelo.

A pessoa Coordenadora de Planejamento Comercial também será responsável por impulsionar a melhoria na disponibilidade de inventário, aumentar a eficiência do estoque, crescimento de seleção e melhorar os processos de compra. A pessoa ideal possui um histórico de implementação e execução bem-sucedida de práticas de gestão de estoque, capacidade analítica e trabalho com equipes multifuncionais. A posição requer um indivíduo que possa trabalhar de forma autônoma em um ambiente frequentemente ambíguo, com atenção aos detalhes. Alem disso, o indivíduo deve ser capaz de gerenciar múltiplos fornecedores simultaneamente e garantir que os itens estejam sempre disponíveis para nossos clientes no Brasil.

A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho, e por isso atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos. No Brasil, estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de áreas e cargos diferentes pois entendemos que essa agenda precisa de diferentes perspectivas e vivências múltiplas. Nossa liderança é engajada e entende cada dia mais o seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos princípios de liderança, com objetivo de sermos “a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo”. Sabemos da nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança e somos conscientes de que “Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades”. Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de DEI. Além disso, atuam como embaixadores dessa agenda e vão te apoiar desde o Day 1. Lembre-se “it’s always Day 1”. Os grupos estão organizados nas seguintes frentes: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e Pessoa com Deficiência.

Key job responsibilities
Gestão de Estoque e Cadeia de Suprimentos:

  1. Gerenciar a cadeia de suprimentos para garantir fluxos eficientes de entrada e saída de estoque, incluindo: previsão, compras e resolução de problemas de recebimento
  2. Trabalhar com fornecedores para garantir um fluxo de mercadorias confiável e operacionalmente efetivo
  3. Entregar máxima seleção disponível na categoria
  4. Desenvolver plano de preparação de estoque para períodos sazonais e promocionais
  5. Controlar orçamentos e executar ações para atingir metas de estoque
  6. Executar planos de ação para reduzir custos de devolução/liquidação

Eficiência Operacional:
  1. Medir e melhorar prazos de compra, reduzir defeitos operacionais e aprimorar sistemas para otimizar operações entre fornecedores e Amazon
  2. Realizar análise/relatório de causa raiz em questões operacionais, desenvolver planos de ação e gerenciar melhorias

Gestão de Projetos:
  1. Trabalhar com equipes internas para impulsionar melhorias/implementação de sistemas, ferramentas e processos que afetam o fluxo de trabalho de compras e gestão de fornecedores, com ênfase na automatização de tarefas atualmente realizadas manualmente
  2. Desenvolver análise de métricas-chave do negócio, com ênfase no desenvolvimento e execução de recomendações para melhoria
  3. Liderar projetos desde o desenvolvimento inicial até a implementação que irão otimizar sistemas e processos de suprimentos e impulsionar melhorias operacionais

Minimum Requirements:
  1. Bacharelado/Licenciatura
  2. Inglês avançado
  3. Experiência em gestão de produto/categoria ou planejamento comercial.
  4. Experiência em logística, cadeia de suprimentos e/ou gestão de suprimentos

  1. Conhecimento dos princípios de controle estatístico de estoque
  2. Experiência com técnicas de melhoria de processos como Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing ou Six Sigma
  3. Proficiência em SQL e conceitos de banco de dados

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Software has moved to play a central role in network technology. From outstanding routing implementations like Bird and FRR to overlay networking technology such as OVN/OVS and Cilium, from kernel with SwitchDev to userspace with DPDK, from P4 to OpenFlow, the relationship between network innovation and software continues to deepen. We are building teams to bring the very best open source networking software to market in a well integrated and opinionated stack that brings the latest hyperscaler innovation to end users and enterprise customers.
We work with networking silicon providers to optimize Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data center networking, from bare metal through virtualization, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.
You will have a good chance of success if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking, with a special interest in the interface of hardware ASICs for acceleration and software for innovation and control. We value experience in open switch initiatives such as SoNIC and DENT, and upstream experience with components such as routing, kernel networking, eBPF, DNS, firewalls and load balancers. Our selection process is rigorous and requires work from the candidate as six to eight interviews over a period of months. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation, security and performance in your work.

title: HPC Software Engineer
description:

Join to apply for the HPC Software Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
HPC is an important and technically challenging compute domain, with specialised tooling and a very high expectation of precision, efficiency and automation. This role is for a software engineer to join our HPC team to deliver an outstanding HPC experience - from bare metal to public cloud - as part of the broader Ubuntu platform. We are looking for a range of skills and experience, and will work on everything from the kernel to Debian packaging, but the heart of our effort will be Python software development for automation of key software in the HPC sphere. Our focus is on delivering a world class experience for the operation of the HPC cluster itself.
You will be part of the team that delivers charms that deploy and manage the HPC cluster and provide HPC software packages.
To succeed in this application you must be outstanding at maths and sciences, have built high quality software, have learned about open source ideally by working on it directly, and be looking for an engineering role with a company that makes mission-critical products for the global market. You should also be familiar with the open source environment, and want to build products in partnership with a community. Ideally, you should have some experience of high performance computing environments and a desire to unlock HPC for the world.
For this role you must have experience with Python. Experience in HPC environments is a strong advantage. Familiarity with HPC hardware and software is also a strong advantage - delivering great experiences with Infiniband, RDMA, CUDA, MPI, Slurm, Lustre, Singularity and related technologies will be central to this team's work. It will also be advantageous to have experience with Docker image design and operations, and public cloud image design and operations.
Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA or the Americas regions
What your day will look like

  • Write high quality, rigorously designed Python software
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Contribute to technical documentation that define best practices for authoring high quality operators
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with writing modern, maintainable Python
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest and experience with two or more of the following: Linux, Kubernetes, Public cloud, OpenStack, LXC/LXD, Python, Go, Debian packaging
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience operating HPC clusters in production
  • Experiences with Infiniband, RDMA, CUDA, MPI, Slurm, Lustre, and/or Singularity
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO. We are looking for a range of experience in these positions - at the high end we are looking for deep experience defending highly contested critical assets and high-value cyber targets against advanced persistent threats and state-level actors. We have more junior roles for exceptional individuals with a proven personal interest an engagement in cyber attack and defence, and outstanding academic and career performance even if experience is limited.
Our goal is to build an entirely new level of assurance and observable rigour into the open source supply chain. We have our own estate to monitor, but more broadly our goal is to raise the robustness of the entire global Ubuntu estate through the work of this team.
The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
What you will do in this role:

  • Implement and evolve Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice

  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials

  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice

What we are looking for

  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
Optional things we value

What we offer you

We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. MAAS components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
At Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.
The successful candidate will have leadership attributes, deep knowledge of Linux, and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.
Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You have experience programming in Python and Go
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
Nice-to-have skills
  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL
Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.
Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .
Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

Vacancy Title: Safety Service Technician

Vacancy Location: Rio De Janeiro, Brazil

Engagement Type: Permanent, Full-Time

The Role:

We are seeking a skilledSafety Service Technician to join our team, bringing expertise in inspecting, diagnosing, and maintaining essential safety systems. This role demands technical proficiency, adaptability, and a service-first approach, with opportunities to work internationally in diverse environments.

Key responsibilities for the Safety Service Technician role include but are not limited to:

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair smoke detection systems, CO2 high-pressure foam inductors, and water mist systems.

  • Inspect and maintain breathing equipment for air cylinders to ensure reliability.
  • Diagnose faults, troubleshoot issues, and execute repairs efficiently.
  • Test and calibrate pressure, flow, and level switches and transmitters.
  • Conduct maintenance in compliance with US and European fire safety system standards.
  • Liaise with supervisors to identify and address repair requirements.
  • Continuously improve processes and procedures to enhance service delivery and efficiency.

You will have the opportunity to develop in your role and feel proud of the work you do. Working at Survitec is fast paced but incredibly rewarding.

This is not just another job; this is your career.

  • Bilingual: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Proven experience in inspecting and maintaining safety systems, including lifeboats, fire-fighting systems, breathing equipment, and fire extinguishers.
  • Technical and mechanical skills, with a focus on diagnosing and repairing faults.
  • Familiarity with US and European fire safety systems is essential.
  • Strong service-oriented mindset with a commitment to safety.
  • Willingness to adapt to varied working conditions and travel internationally.
  • Capable of working under pressure and independently.
  • Computer literacy for reporting and documentation.
  • Experience in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing safety systems.
  • Experienced in inspecting and testing pressure, flow, and level switches and transmitters.
  • Able to liaise effectively with supervisors and team members to ensure seamless operations.

Survitec are the world’s largest survival technology provider. For over 166 years, we have been protecting lives in the air, on land and at sea, through the design, manufacture, and servicing of Survival Technology.

Today, we are a global community of 3,000 professionals with presence in 96 countries partnering with our customers to provide innovative solutions that reduce risk and help keep you safe.

That's why the world's leading maritime, defence & government, energy and aerospace organisations trust us when it matters most and why we have been awarded the Gold Award by the Defence Employer Recognition Scheme

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Desde 2019, o projeto Acolhidos por meio do Trabalho tem sido implementado com o propósito de melhorar as condições de vida e fomentar a dignidade das pessoas refugiadas e migrantes venezuelanas no Brasil. O projeto opera em quatro esferas: a primeira atuando no fortalecimento das capacidades individuais para promover a autonomia, por meio da realização de cursos profissionalizantes e de português destinados à população abrigada; a segunda na facilitação do processo de integração socioeconômico em novas localidades por meio da estratégia de interiorização; a terceira no aprimoramento das condições de vida, saúde e higiene dos venezuelanos abrigados, através de atividades relacionadas à WASH; e a quarta esfera se baseia na construção de um cultivo urbano agroecológio destinado à população indígena abrigada.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O(a) Assistente de Compras será responsável por realizar e acompanhar as atividades de compras do projeto “Acolhidos por meio do Trabalho”, apoiar em atividades administrativas relativas à interiorização, a nível nacional, apoiando os escritórios de Boa Vista/RR, Brasília/DF e Chapecó/SC. A pessoa ficará baseada em Brasília e atuará diretamente no suporte à logística e de aquisições, assegurando a conformidade com os procedimentos internos e as exigências do financiador, garantindo a padronização, eficiência e transparência administrativa.

Suporte administrativo geral às operações do projeto em Boa Vista/RR, Brasília/DF e Chapecó/SC, garantindo organização e fluxo adequado de documentos e informações.

Apoio aos processos de interiorização de venezuelanos, incluindo organização de documentos, logística de entrega de móveis, materiais e articulação com equipes dos escritórios de Boa Vista/RR e Chapecó/SC.

Organização e controle de documentos físicos e digitais, assegurando arquivamento correto e rastreabilidade de informações conforme os padrões do financiador.

Acompanhamento de processos de compras e contratações locais, garantindo conformidade com os procedimentos internos da AVSI Brasil e exigências do doador.

Lançamento e controle de dados administrativos e financeiros, como requisições, pagamentos, planilhas e comprovantes.

Comunicação direta com fornecedores, coleta de orçamentos e envio de solicitações administrativas conforme a demanda da equipe técnica.

Colaboração na elaboração de relatórios administrativos e de prestação de contas, fornecendo informações atualizadas e documentos comprobatórios.

Articulação interna com as demais áreas da organização, assegurando a integração das rotinas administrativas com os objetivos do projeto.

Utiliza ferramentas e instrumentos apropriados para recondicionar o veículo e assegurar seu funcionamento regular. Atender quando solicitado serviços de assistência externa.

  • Reparação de freios : Inspeção e substituição de pastilhas, discos e cilindros de freio, ajuste de freio de mão, verificação do fluido de freio e identificação de desgastes ou falhas no sistema.
  • Sistema de arrefecimento : Manutenção e troca do líquido de arrefecimento, verificação do radiador, inspeção de mangueiras e conexões, teste do termostato e substituição da bomba de água.

  • Reparação sistema de iluminação : Verificação e substituição de lâmpadas, faróis, lanternas e fusíveis; ajuste dos faróis para garantir boa visibilidade e segurança ao dirigir.
  • Reparação de motores : Diagnóstico de problemas de desempenho, substituição de peças desgastadas, ajustes e manutenção do motor para assegurar potência e eficiência.
  • Substituição de acessórios : Instalação e substituição de acessórios, como retrovisores, para-choques, limpadores de para-brisa, e demais componentes que complementam a funcionalidade e estética do veículo.
  • Diagnósticos : Uso de equipamentos de diagnóstico para identificar problemas em diversos sistemas do veículo, incluindo eletrônica, injeção eletrônica, ar condicionado e mais.
  • Lavagem de peças : Limpeza de componentes automotivos para remover sujeira, graxa e resíduos, garantindo a manutenção da eficiência e longevidade das peças.
  • Reparação de sistema pneumático : Manutenção de sistemas de ar comprimido, como em freios pneumáticos; verificação e reparo de válvulas, compressores e cilindros para assegurar a eficácia do sistema.

description:
Quem somos?

Somos uma empresa de produtos de tecnologia corporativa. Temos mais de 15 anos de história e estamos só no começo! description:
Apoiar a segurança jurídica da empresa por meio da análise e gestão de questões legais, assegurando a conformidade com a legislação vigente, mitigando riscos e contribuindo para a tomada de decisões estratégicas com responsabilidade e integridade.

  • Gerenciar Processos Judiciais e Administrativos: Auxiliar na condução e acompanhamento de processos jurídicos da empresa, elaborando peças processuais simples (como contestações e recursos) sob supervisão; acompanhar prazos; participar de audiências quando necessário; e registrar todas as informações no sistema RR Juridico, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos legais e garantindo a defesa dos interesses da empresa;

  • Prevenir Riscos Jurídicos: Realizar pesquisas legais e análises preventivas, jurisprudência, legislação aplicável e possíveis implicações jurídicas em decisões estratégicas, antecipando os riscos legais e protegendo a empresa de possíveis litígios ou penalidades;
  • Apoiar a Área de Compliance e Regulatório: Colaborar na implementação e no monitoramento de políticas de compliance e conformidade regulatória, participando da construção de programas internos, revisando políticas da empresa e acompanhando obrigações legais específicas do setor fabril, garantindo que as operações estejam de acordo com as normas legais e regulatórias, evitando sanções e promovendo práticas éticas;
  • Participar de Reuniões e Fornecer Suporte Jurídico: Atuar como apoio jurídico em decisões empresariais e projetos internos; participar de reuniões interdepartamentais, analisando aspectos legais das iniciativas da empresa e fornecendo pareceres quando necessário, assegurando que todas as decisões estejam alinhadas com a legislação para mitigação dos riscos jurídicos;

  • Solicitar e Consolidar Pareceres Jurídicos: Solicitar pareceres e levantar informações necessárias para instruir decisões jurídicas, reunindo dados de diferentes áreas, organizando informações e encaminhando solicitações para advogados internos, apoiando decisões estratégicas com embasamento legal sólido;
  • Assegurar Conformidade com Normas Internas e Externas: Analisar os procedimentos internos sob a ótica legal, revisando políticas, práticas e normas internas para garantir conformidade com legislações aplicáveis e diretrizes do grupo empresarial;

  2. Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world.

Summary

The Operations team at Latitude.sh is responsible for ensuring the seamless functioning of our global infrastructure. While provisioning new servers and IT infrastructure is essential, our mission is to maintain high availability, ensure rapid response times, and deliver exceptional service quality to our clients.

We are seeking a Senior Operations Analyst to join our team, working on the second (01:00 PM to 10:00 PM) or third shift (10:00 PM to 07:00 AM).   • Lead the execution and coordination of operational tasks involving infrastructure services – including servers, storage, networking equipment, and platform software;
  • Perform and oversee rack and stack activities, hardware installation, and in-cabinet maintenance;
  • Manage relationships and workflows with remote data center techs, ensuring adherence to operational standards and procedures;
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows operating systems;
  • Conduct root cause analysis and handle complex issues related to hardware failures, RAID rebuilds, storage allocation, and disk lifecycle management;
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot out-of-band management platforms such as IPMI/BMC;
  • Support and improve internal operational documentation, workflows, and escalation procedures;
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Advanced English communication skills (B2 or higher);
  • Proven experience with server hardware, including diagnostics, replacements, and upgrades;
  • Strong understanding of data center standards, rack layouts, cabling, power distribution (PDU), and remote hands coordination;
  • Proficiency with monitoring platforms, ticketing systems, and incident handling workflows;
  • Solid knowledge of Linux system administration (CentOS, Ubuntu, or similar), including command line operations, scripting, and performance tuning;
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server environments;
  • Familiarity with RAID technologies, disk provisioning, and troubleshooting storage systems;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or similar working experience;
  • Prior experience in a senior role within a data center operations or infrastructure support team is a strong plus.

What do we offer?

  • Competitive Compensation;
  • Annual Bonus based on company and team performance;
  • Work Anniversary bonus;
  • Transportation or fuel voucher (without discounts);
  • Subsidies for education, certification and English courses;
  • Partnership with SESC extended to dependents.

Why Latitude.sh?

We're a lean, agile team of passionate professionals who believe in the power of innovation and creative problem-solving. As part of our team, you won't be lost in the crowd – you'll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one.

Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We're proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality, or disability. If these values speak to you, we'd love for you to become a part of our team.

O primeiro restaurante surgiu em 2004, na Vila Olímpia, em São Paulo e não parou de crescer. 20 anos depois, a marca conta com quase 1.000 "Juans", como são carinhosamente chamados seus colaboradores, em suas 16 unidades nas 6 regiões do Brasil.

EXCELÊNCIA
Temos a mentalidade de sempre, o tempo todo, buscar o que há de melhor. Não aceitamos ser, ter ou fazer menos do que o melhor.
DESEMPENHO
Em todas as nossas atividades, almejamos alcançar resultados norteados pela excelência, produtividade e satisfação máximas.
INOVAÇÃO
Estamos sempre atentos às tendências do mercado e empenhados em trazer novas ideias e soluções criativas para aprimorar nossos produtos e serviços.
SUSTENTABILIDADE
Extremamente comprometidos com práticas empresariais responsáveis, visando o equilíbrio entre crescimento econômico, bem-estar social e preservação ambiental. Minimizamos nosso impacto ambiental ao adotar medidas e práticas sustentáveis.
DIVERSÃO
Todos os envolvidos com a marca devem se divertir. A diversão é um elemento fundamental em todas as interações com nossa marca. Queremos que todos os envolvidos com nosso negócio desfrutem de momentos alegres e descontraídos, afinal a alegria e o prazer estão sempre presentes em nossas casas. A diversão não apenas enriquece as relações humanas, mas também contribui para um ambiente mais leve e produtivo.

Apoiamos o desenvolvimento profissional dos nossos juans. Oferecemos treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades de crescimento.

Nosso compromisso é oferecer uma experiência gastronômica excepcional aos nossos clientes. Para isso, buscamos profissionais que compartilhem dessa paixão pela excelência.

title: Gerente de Marketing
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Empresa consolidada no mercado busca um(a) Gerente de Marketing para liderar a área, desenvolvendo estratégias de fortalecimento da marca, aumento de visibilidade e apoio direto às áreas comerciais. A atuação será voltada para marketing institucional, digital, campanhas promocionais e geração de valor ao negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar o planejamento estratégico de marketing alinhado aos objetivos da empresa.

  • Gerenciar campanhas institucionais, promocionais e sazonais em canais online e offline.

  • Supervisionar as estratégias de marketing digital (redes sociais, mídia paga, SEO, site e e-mail marketing).

  • Apoiar áreas comerciais com materiais de captação e ações de marketing de vendas.

  • Gerenciar fornecedores como agências, gráficas e produtores de conteúdo.

  • Liderar a equipe de marketing, promovendo desenvolvimento e foco em resultados.

  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas.

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Marketing Digital, Estratégia ou Branding será um diferencial.

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em funções de marketing, campanhas, branding e liderança de equipes.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Estratégias de inbound e outbound marketing e gestão de funil de vendas.

  • Branding, gestão de marca e inteligência de mercado.

  • Domínio de ferramentas como Google Ads, Meta Business, RD Station, CRMs e análise de dados (Google Analytics, Power BI).

  • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas de automação e edição de conteúdo (Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere).

Necessário experiência em

  • Liderança estratégica de marketing.

  • Criação e gestão de campanhas online e offline.

  • Desenvolvimento e fortalecimento de marca.

  • Análise de indicadores de marketing para tomada de decisão.

description:
Join to apply for the Permit to Work Coordinator role at ICM People do Brasil .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

ICM is recruiting Permit to Work Coordinator

Requirements

  • High school diploma required.
  • Technical degree in Occupational Safety, Engineering, Offshore Operations, or related fields is preferred.
  • PTW Coordinator training (internal company program or third-party courses such as OPITO Permit to Work Coordinator Training).
  • NR-10, NR-33, NR-35 (for Brazil-based roles).
  • OSHA Standards (for international or U.S.-based projects).
  • H2S Awareness (for hydrogen sulfide risk environments).
  • LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) – Energy Isolation Procedures.
  • Risk Assessment & Job Safety Analysis (JSA).
  • BOSIET (Basic Offshore Safety Induction and Emergency Training) for offshore operations.
  • Previous experience as a PTW Coordinator, Safety Officer, or Supervisor involved in Permit to Work systems.
  • Practical knowledge of industrial/offshore work activities and related operational risks.

Responsibilities

  1. Supervise and manage the Permit To Work system on site.
  2. Review, approve, and issue work permits for critical activities (e.g., hot work, confined space entry, working at height, electrical work, excavations, heavy lifting).
  3. Ensure that risk assessments are attached and validated for each PTW issued.
  4. Coordinate the interface between different teams, ensuring clear communication about activity risks.
  5. Conduct site inspections to confirm that the conditions described in the PTW are being followed.
  6. Perform internal audits of the PTW system, promoting continuous improvements.
  7. Participate in daily safety meetings (toolbox talks) and task planning meetings.
  8. Report deviations, non-conformities, and incidents related to the PTW process.

title: Especialista de Transporte, Sort Center
description:
Job ID: 2866658 | Amazon Logistica do Brasil - F95

O SC (Sort Center) está em busca de profissionais engajados e apaixonados por inovação para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial, garantindo entregas dentro do prazo e com a máxima eficiência de custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é operar com excelência, otimizando capacidades e monitorando em tempo real as operações do Sort Center no Brasil, realizando o acompanhamento hora a hora e fornecendo análises detalhadas dos dados operacionais.


Esse papel requer um profissional proativo e com espírito de liderança. Você representará uma posição estratégica nas operações de transporte da Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos constantemente para melhorar os níveis de serviço, a eficiência das capacidades e a otimização dos custos do Sort Center Brasil. Isso garantirá que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas de forma consistente.


Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento FCs / ATS Middle Mile / TOM e AMZL, garantindo que nossas capacidades sejam sempre atingidas com excelência e ainda garantindo a visibilidade dessas capacidades para as áreas parceiras e para a gerência senior da operação.


Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de resolver problemas com agilidade, utilizando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões assertivas em tempo real. É essencial compreender os requisitos, analisar dados, identificar tendências e impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem impactar os prazos estabelecidos. Conhecimentos básicos em logística e habilidades de comunicação claras, tanto na forma escrita quanto oral, são indispensáveis. Além disso, o profissional deve propor melhorias nos processos e ter a determinação de implementá-las até a conclusão.


Essa posição estará envolvida na expansão do Sort Center no Brasil, trabalhando em turnos de 3x2.


Modelo de trabalho: Presencial, em turnos pela escala 3x2. É necessário ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários / turnos / áreas flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana, noites e/ou feriados.


Key job responsibilities

  1. Estabelecer comunicação eficiente com clientes externos (ATS Middle Mile, TOM, Time de Operações do Sort Center e AMZL) e clientes internos (centros de atendimento ROC, estações de entrega);
  2. Possuir capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é um diferencial desejável;
  3. Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho relevantes para impulsionar os resultados do negócio;
  4. Entender rapidamente o impacto das tendências nos resultados comerciais e tomar decisões com base nos dados disponíveis;
  5. Encaminhar de forma estruturada problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes, garantindo a execução de soluções;
  6. Trabalhar dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, mensurando e identificando as atividades realizadas;
  7. Responder pelo gerenciamento de capacidade de linha e gerenciamento de volume, incluindo a realização de uploads de limites de capacidade no sistema;
  8. Garantir visibilidade às atividades de Capacidades, fornecendo suporte direto ao time de operações.

A day in the life

O Sort Center é o Middle Mile (MM), uma parte da estrutura da Amazon Transportation Service (ATS), onde os pacotes são enviados para serem consolidados de diferentes origens e serem classificados e enviados ao destino para melhorar a velocidade de entrega, a ocupação do veículo e a frequência da rota. A estratégia do Sort Center para o Brasil tem como objetivo desenvolver nossa rede de transporte apoiando a expansão dos programas da AMZL, Amazon Air e Market Place.

description:
Good Shepherd Rehabilitation · Good Shepherd Specialty Hospital

Full Time (36+ hrs/wk), Night Shift - 12 hours, 7:00pm-7:30am

JOB SUMMARY

The respiratory therapist will perform specific duties and responsibilities as outlined. Under medical supervision, the individual must be able to adapt to the particular area of assignment and be able to perform accordingly.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. DELIVERS QUALITY CARE
    By integrating the elements of examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prognosis and intervention to optimize outcomes.
    By optimizing patient independence.
    By administering inhalants and aerosolized medications, performing bronchial hygiene, operating mechanical ventilators, delivering therapeutic gas administration, and by performing hyperinflation modalities per established respiratory protocols.
    Perform cardiopulmonary and hemological diagnostic studies.
  2. PROMOTES SAFE AND CLEAN WORKING ENVIRONMENT
    By complying with policies and procedures, rules and regulations governing environment of care and patient safety.
  3. DETERMINES AND/OR FACILITATES DISCHARGE/DISCONTINUATION OF SERVICES
    By analyzing achievement of anticipated goals and expected outcomes, planning discharge/discontinuation and providing appropriate home instruction, follow-up or referral.
  4. RECORDS PATIENT SERVICES
    By documenting, dating and authenticating respiratory therapy examination, evaluation, diagnosis, prognosis, intervention and outcomes in accordance with facility and regulatory guidelines.
    By billing for specific interventions provided.
  5. DEVELOPS AND ENHANCES PROFESSIONAL KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
    By participating in continuing education to maintain licensure, reviewing professional publications and providing learning experiences for professional development.
  6. CONTRIBUTES TO TEAM EFFORT
    By embracing change to achieve common goals, demonstrating willingness to provide service at other sites as necessary, investigating opportunities for new lines of services, contributing to the development of peers and promoting a positive work environment and by accomplishing related results as needed.
  7. COMPLIES WITH FEDERAL, STATE AND LOCAL LEGAL AND PROFESSIONAL REQUIREMENTS
    By understanding and adhering to current standards of practice for respiratory therapy, guide for professional conduct including the code of ethics and practice guidelines established by the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
    By providing appropriate supervision to other healthcare professionals and coworkers.
  8. ENSURES OPERATION OF EQUIPMENT
    By completing preventive maintenance requirements, following manufacturer’s instructions, troubleshooting malfunctions, calling for repairs.
  9. PROTECTS PATIENT INFORMATION AND CONFIDENTIALITY
    By securing all information in confidential space, following facility confidentiality policy.
  10. CONTRIBUTES TO PI TEAM EFFORTS
    By assisting the Clinical Resource Specialist with data collection, monitoring, analyzing and reporting.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education
Associate's Degree in Respiratory Therapy required
Bachelor's Degree in Respiratory Therapy preferred

Work Experience
1-2 years of experience required
Clinical experience in all areas of respiratory care is preferred

Licenses / Certifications
Registered Respiratory Therapy license required
BLS/CPR for a healthcare provider, per the American Heart Association required

GOOD SHEPHERD'S UNIVERSAL FLU PROGRAM
As a health-care provider, we have a professional and ethical obligation to protect our patients and residents from developing further complications.
To protect our patients and residents, Good Shepherd requires influenza (flu) vaccinations for all Associates, licensed independent practitioners, contracted, agency and temporary employees, students and volunteers.
