Na Minerva Foods, líder na exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul, a área de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas desempenha um papel crucial no avanço tecnológico da empresa. Com operações em mais de 100 países e uma presença global que abrange o Brasil, Argentina, Colômbia, Paraguai, Uruguai e Austrália, a equipe de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas é responsável por criar e implementar soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que impulsionam nosso negócio e sustentam as operações da empresa em atendimento aos cinco continentes.

A missão da área de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas é fornecer soluções de TI que não apenas satisfaçam as necessidades operacionais cotidianas, mas também capacitem as operações estratégicas da empresa. Desenvolvemos sistemas robustos e eficientes que são cruciais para o funcionamento das unidades industriais, centros de distribuição e oficinas internacionais.

Nosso foco é garantir que a tecnologia esteja sempre alinhada com as melhores práticas e tendências do mercado, diferenciando-nos estrategicamente dos concorrentes. Estamos comprometidos em melhorar continuamente nossos processos e produtos para fornecer um suporte técnico de excelência que aumente a competitividade da Minerva Foods.

As soluções desenvolvidas pela nossa equipe impactam diretamente o EBITDA da empresa, garantindo que as decisões estratégicas e operacionais sejam fundamentadas em sistemas confiáveis e inovadores. Mantemos um diálogo contínuo com a camada executiva e estamos engajados em promover mudanças que aperfeiçoem nossa cultura e processos internos. Através de nossa dedicação à excelência em desenvolvimento de software, direcionamos a Minerva Foods para um futuro tecnicamente avançado e operacionalmente eficiente.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Participação de projetos transversais às diretorias, atuando no ciclo completo de seu desenvolvimento: identificação de oportunidade, definição de escopo, idealização de solução, acompanhamento e report do andamento do projeto, validação de solução proposta, capacitação de usuários e suporte para dúvidas do produto desenvolvido;

Traduzir as necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas de desenvolvimento de sistemas, considerando as melhores práticas em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Desenvolvimento Ágil. Apresentar, de maneira clara e recorrente, o progresso e os resultados dos projetos em andamento;
  • Possuir conhecimento dos métodos e processos da companhia de maneira a identificar gargalos e oportunidades em outras áreas e defender de maneira sólida, a necessidade do desenvolvimento de novos projetos ou produtos de TI;
  • Possuir conhecimento abrangente dos sistemas e soluções desenvolvidas de forma a responder a questionamentos técnicos e de utilização desses produtos para Analistas e Coordenadores das áreas cliente, garantindo que todas as soluções estejam documentadas e que sejam fornecidos treinamentos necessários para o correto uso pelas equipes envolvidas.

title: Finance Manager - Accounting & Tax
description:
Tax & Accounting Manager - Telecommunications

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

The Tax & Accounting Manager role sits within the Financial Control team, reporting directly to the Head of Treasury, Risk and Compliance, and is based out of our São Paulo, Brazil office. The primary focus will be on Brazilian financial management, including accounting, tax compliance, and regulatory financial reporting for our MVNO operations in Brazil. The role will oversee financial operations for our registrations in both São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. As 1GLOBAL expands its MVNO operations in the Brazilian market, this role offers exposure to a wide range of financial areas—accounting, tax compliance, regulatory reporting, and financial planning—within the complex Brazilian telecommunications regulatory environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a finance professional with telecommunications experience looking to develop in a fast-growing, multinational environment with diverse and evolving financial and regulatory challenges.

The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Manage all accounting operations for 1GLOBAL's Brazilian entities, ensuring compliance with Brazilian accounting standards (including CPC/IFRS) and practices.
  • Prepare financial statements for Brazilian operations in accordance with local requirements.
  • Coordinate with global finance teams to ensure alignment with group reporting and audit requirements.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors for Brazilian operations, including statutory audits.

Tax Compliance & Filing

  • Prepare and file all federal tax returns (including IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS), state tax returns (ICMS), and municipal tax returns (ISS) in Brazil.
  • Oversee the preparation and submission of ancillary tax obligations such as ECD, ECF, EFD-ICMS/IPI, EFD-Contribuições, SPED, and DIRF.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian transfer pricing rules for intercompany transactions.
  • Stay current with Brazilian tax legislation changes and ensure company compliance, particularly with telecommunications-specific tax regulations.

Regulatory Financial Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with Anatel financial reporting requirements for MVNOs, including periodic financial submissions.
  • Oversee payment and management of TFI (Installation Inspection Fee) and TFF (Operation Inspection Fee) for activated devices.
  • Ensure proper financial record-keeping for regulatory audits and inspections.
  • Coordinate with legal and regulatory teams on financial aspects of telecommunications compliance.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field.
  • Professional accounting qualification (e.g., CRC - Conselho Regional de Contabilidade).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in financial roles in Brazil.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian accounting standards and tax regulations.
  • Experience managing tax registrations and compliance across multiple Brazilian jurisdictions, specifically São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro.
  • Proven experience with Brazilian tax reporting systems including SPED (Sistema Público de Escrituração Digital).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience with mobile network operators or other telecommunications service providers in Brazil.
  • Experience with Brazilian telecommunications taxation specifics, including FUST and FUNTEL contributions.
  • Knowledge of NetSuite and Vertex.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

Description & Requirements
Resumes must be submitted in English to be considered
BloombergNEF (BNEF) is a strategic research provider covering global commodity markets and the disruptive technologies driving the transition to a low-carbon economy. We help our clients gain a clear perspective on the trends in technology, finance, policy and economics that are driving transformation across the energy value chain. Our expert coverage assesses pathways for the power, transport, industry, buildings and agriculture sectors to adapt to the energy transition. We help commodity trading, corporate strategy, finance and policy professionals navigate change and generate opportunities. BNEF has 300 staff based in 20 offices across the globe.
BNEF Team Ethos:
To succeed at BNEF we need people who can work in an independent manner and show initiative to develop their own viewpoints, yet be collaborative with colleagues. We don't rely on the status quo, we look for innovative yet pragmatic thinking that turns big ideas into real insights and impact. Working at BNEF sometimes feels chaotic; we need teams that are both dynamic and structured to generate the unique perspectives our clients really value. Our teams are diverse, creative, focused, and fun!
The Role:
We are seeking a talented, highly motivated native Spanish Speaker to join our Latin America research team as a an analyst based in Sao Paulo. You're one of those people who have a real passion for energy transition, and you want to be at the forefront of this exciting industry. You naturally form original opinions and have an outstanding ability to communicate these to your audience. Your quantitative skills are strong and you love to analyze critically complex subjects. You will be responsible for undertaking primary research and analysis on energy transition in Latin America, producing written reports, presentations, tools and other products. You will also be answering client requests and supporting business development through client interactions in English, Spanish and/or Portuguese.
We'll trust you to:
* Develop and implement market-driving products, data sets, forecasts, and tools
* Collaborate with a high degree of integrity with colleagues and clients from different cultures and countries
* Together with other team members, identify topics of interest to clients, conduct research, and report on the findings in a timely manner
* Help our customers truly get to grips with the landscape of energy transition in Latin America
* Present your research at conferences and clearly communicate it to clients and prospects
* Analyze complex subjects both quantitatively and qualitatively, and make them understandable and relevant to a wide range of clients with different concerns
* Demonstrate excellent, well-practiced quantitative skills
* Form creative opinions, graphically present data and write clearly and concisely
* Balance multiple parallel tasks, be highly organized and have rigorous attention to detail
You'll need to have:
* At least 2 years of experience in energy or commodities gained within a research, analysis, consulting, publishing, trading, energy/utilities, financial or investment environment
* Native Spanish written and spoken
* Fluent English written and spoken
* Proficient in Excel including experience working with large datasets and building models
* Bachelor's degree in scientific, engineering, economics or humanities discipline
* Confidence and accuracy conducting numerical analysis and familiarity with data
* Demonstrated continuous career growth within an organization
* Resumes must be submitted in English to be considered
We'd love to see:
* Knowledge of decarbonization technologies, policies and commodities markets
* Professional experience in Mexico, or other Latin American countries
* Fluency in written and spoken Portuguese
* Proficiency and experience with SQL and/or Python
* Masters degree

A maioria dos postos de trabalho pede Ensino Médio Completo. Os salários e benefícios variam de acordo com a função. Há remuneração de R$1,4 mil até R$2 mil.

Para participar da seleção o candidato precisa preencher o cadastro pelo sistemaEmprega Brasil ou no atendimento presencial na Casa do Trabalhador, no setor amarelo do Ganha Tempo, que fica na Avenida Henriqueta Mendes Guerra, 550 – Centro.

O interessado também pode se inscrever no processo seletivo peloApp Sine Fácil , no celular. A ativação do aplicativo deve ser feita pelo QR Code fornecido em atendimento presencial na Casa do Trabalhador.

Confira as vagas:

Analista de recursos humanos: ensino médio completo, salário à combinar (vt+ta). Responsabilidade: processar a documentação e preparar relatórios com as atividades do pessoal (agenciamento, recrutamento, treinamento, reclamações, avaliações de desempenho, entre outras).

Assistente administrativo: ensino médio completo, R$1.596,00 (cb+vt). Atendimento ao cliente, captação de clientes, emissão de pedidos, controle de estoque, expedição e recebimento de mercadoria.

Assistente de vendas: ensino médio completo, R$2.000,00 (vt+ta). Atendimento ao cliente via telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail, prospetar clientes, abrir novos nichos de mercado, planilhas de Excel, word.

Atendente de lanchonete: ensino médio completo, R$1.690,00 (ta+vt+vr). Atendente deve possuir empatia e espírito vendedor para lidar com clientes, tanto pessoalmente quanto pelo WhatsApp. Deverá preparar os pedidos operando os equipamentos da loja e manter o ambiente de trabalho limpo.

Auxiliar administrativo: ensino médio completo, salário à combinar (vt+vr). Atendimento ao cliente, emissão de contrato, separação dos pedidos e apoio ao departamento comercial e faturamento.

Auxiliar de limpeza: fundamental completo, R$1.456,00 (ta+am+ao+vt). Limpeza de condomínios residenciais e comerciais.

Auxiliar de manutenção predial: ensino médio completo, R$1.530,00 (cb+vt). Inspecionar atividades em manutenção corretiva e preventiva de instalações serviços de limpeza equipamentos e máquinas; identificar as deficiências operacionais e funcionais que atendem as necessidades de infraestrutura.

Auxiliar de manutenção predial: fundamental completo, R$1.572,00 (ao+vt+am+ta). Manutenção em condomínios residenciais e comerciais, experiência com alvenaria, elétrica, hidráulica, pintura e manutenção de piscina.

Auxiliar de mecânico de autos: ensino médio completo, R$1.600,00 (cb). Ter conhecimento com trocas de pneus, pastilhas de freio, sistema de suspensão, troca de embreagem, alinhamento, balanceamento, dentre outros serviços ligado ao ramo de auxiliar de mecânico automotivo.

Auxiliar de técnico de controle de qualidade: ensino médio completo, R$1.800,00 (vt). Auxiliar na inspeção e liberação de produtos acabados, realizando todo acompanhamento de processos. Vaga correta: auxiliar de controle de qualidade – monitora a qualidade da produção na empresa, verifica os procedimentos operacionais de higiene e boas práticas de fabricação.

Costureira de máquina reta: ensino médio completo, R$1.822,30 (ta+sv+plr+vt+ao). Costureira com habilidade para trabalhar em máquina reta eletrônica, para aplicação de zíper em vestuário.

Cozinheiro geral: fundamental completo, R$1.425,00 (cb+vt). Receber conferir e armazenar todos os gêneros destinados a preparação da merenda a fim de conservar melhor o mesmo; auxiliar diariamente no cardápio para verificar falta de algum produto; auxiliar e cuidar da limpeza e manutenção do material e locais destinados a preparação estocagem e distribuição dos alimentos; armazenar alimentos de forma correta e conserva-los em perfeito estado para o consumo; cuidar do pré-preparo das refeições lavando, descascando, cortando, temperando os alimentos.

Encarregado de costura na confecção do vestuário: ensino médio completo, R$1.998,00 (ta+sv+plr+vt+ao). Supervisionam equipes de trabalho; organizam dados de produção de corte e costura, definindo metas, organizando cronogramas, dimensionando a capacidade de produção. Controlam recursos para produção. Administram metas e resultados da produção, analisando relatórios, custos e registros. Controlam a qualidade dos produtos, determinando padrões de produção, avaliando satisfação de clientes, inspecionando a qualidade dos produtos.

Engenheiro de manutenção elétrica: superior incompleto, salário à combinar (ta+outros). Executam serviços elétricos, eletrônicos e de telecomunicações, analisando propostas técnicas, instalando, configurando e inspecionando sistemas e equipamentos, executando testes e ensaios. Projetam, planejam e especificam sistemas e equipamentos elétricos, eletrônicos e de telecomunicações e elaboram sua documentação técnica.

Garçom: ensino médio completo, R$1.690,66 (vt+outros). Atendimento de clientes, anotação de pedidos, serviço de mesa.

Jardineiro: fundamental completo, R$1.586,30 (vt+cb+outros). Executar atividades pertinentes a jardinagem sobre terrenos planos e taludes, tais como: aparar grama, plantio, preparação de solo, manejo de soprador de folhas e máquinas de poda.

Motorista entregador: ensino médio completo, R$2.073,50 (vt+cb). Entrega de mercadorias congeladas e secas, cobrança dos pedidos via cartão. Desejável experiência nas categorias A e B para veículos.

Vendedor porta a porta: ensino médio completo, R$1.807,67. Realizar vendas para distribuidora de materiais de construção, situada em Sorocaba, experiência com vendas externas (manutenção e prospecção de cliente) de materiais para construção, bebidas, cigarros, rações ou outros ramos com experiência em vendas de pulverização. Com veículo, de preferência.

title: Country Manager / CEO Brazil - EdTech
description:
The purpose of this role is to support this international company in entering a critical phase of international expansion, with Brazil as a strategic growth market. The company is seeking to establish a strong local presence, starting with the recruitment of a Country Manager/CEO who will lead the Brazilian operation. This leader will be responsible for translating the company’s global strategy into a locally relevant approach, building the business from the ground up, and positioning the company as a key player in Brazil’s corporate learning ecosystem.

The company value proposition is distinct: it targets B2B clients with high-value contracts, offering a platform that supports not just content delivery but also strategic learning design, engagement, and performance tracking. The company’s model is not based on low-cost subscriptions or individual sales; it is built around long-term partnerships with organizations seeking to transform their learning culture. To succeed in Brazil, we must educate the market, build trust, and demonstrate the platform’s potential to support learning before, during, and after key business processes. The ideal Country Manager/CEO will be someone who understands both the Brazilian business environment and global edtech trends. They must be hands-on, entrepreneurial, and capable of wearing multiple hats, from sales and operations to strategy and team development.

This is a rare opportunity to lead the growth of a purpose-driven company that believes in lifelong learning and inclusive education. The role demands curiosity, resilience, and a deep commitment to delivering value, not just through technology, but through meaningful human connection. The future of learning in Brazil is ready to be shaped, and we are looking for a leader who can make that vision a reality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Market Leadership & Strategic Positioning - Lead the establishment of the company in Brazil by translating the global strategy into a locally relevant narrative. Educate the market on the platform’s broader value beyond content delivery, positioning it as a strategic infrastructure for corporate learning and development.
  • Business Development & Revenue Growth - Drive sales and build long-term relationships through consultative and relational approaches. Identify opportunities in traditional and digital channels to ensure financial sustainability and market growth penetration.
  • Client-Centric Innovation & Product Adaptation - Actively listen to clients and users to understand their needs and behaviors. Use these insights to guide the development of new features, products, and tailored solutions that maximize the platform’s potential in Brazil.
  • Operational Setup & Compliance - Oversee the legal, financial, and operational setup of the Brazilian entity, ensuring full compliance with local regulations. Build the foundation for scalable operations while maintaining the agility and responsiveness of a startup.
  • Team Building & Cross-Functional Leadership - Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing local team. Operate across sales, operations, and product feedback while fostering a collaborative, purpose-driven culture.
  • Execution & Strategic Agility - Balance strategic thinking with tactical execution. Deliver results in a resource-constrained environment, acting with urgency, humility, and resilience to build traction, credibility, and trust in the market.

The Candidate

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Understand and navigate Brazil’s business culture and regulatory environment, as well as the global market and its peculiarities of CLM companies and their need to innovate.
  • Achieve a flow comparable to the Brazilian market to be recognized as innovative and to compete at various levels within this niche, including corporate, LMS, services, digital learning, and others.
  • Leverage the wheelchair's autonomy to expand the business in Brazil by attentively listening to clients' needs and identifying or developing technological and commercial solutions aimed at benefiting the clients.
  • Educate the market on the value of a comprehensive learning platform rather than a content-focused organization, assisting clients in developing and promoting content for their own related purposes.
  • Act with a focus on business expansion, initially through traditional B2B sales, and subsequently develop direct or digital sales solutions if such opportunities are identified in Brazil.
  • Learn how users in Brazil utilize the platform to develop new features, products, and tailored solutions to the Brazilian market by attentively listening to users and maximizing its potential.
  • Operate with limited initial resources while building traction and revenue, identifying and unlocking the full potential of the platform’s underutilized features for Brazil.
  • Balance strategic thinking with tactical execution in a startup environment, building credibility and trust with clients through a deep understanding of their needs.
  • Manage legal, financial, and operational setup in compliance with Brazilian regulations.
  • Scale operations sustainably while maintaining startup agility.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Proven experience in startups or tech companies, ideally in edtech, SaaS, or digital platforms.
  • Fluency in technology, able to understand product development cycles and digital solutions, very welcome, former hands-on tech person.
  • Experience launching or scaling businesses in Brazil or similar emerging markets, from early stages, cultural shifts, and/or financial expansion and product development.
  • Experience in small to mid-sized organizations with hands-on operational leadership or developing related areas in large companies.
  • Strong track record in B2B consultative sales and client relationship management, preferably in structured sales organizations and KPI-driven environments to solidify the company in Brazil.
  • Solid experience with execution and a comprehensive view, acting with overall leadership in an executive and hands-on manner at different moments and divisions of a company, from sales to legal.
  • Generation of new business, acting in a consultative and relational manner to establish long-term partnerships and ensure financial longevity.
  • Taking responsibility for direct sales actions, prospecting teams, clients for new business acquisition, and sales expansion in Brazil.
  • Knowledge and experience with CLM (Content, Learning, Meeting), LMS (Learning Management System), Corporate Education, Services & Contents, or related will be a differential.
  • Proficiency in English communication will be essential for reporting to an international founder and functioning at an international level.

Behaviors Skills

  • Humble and collaborative – leads with empathy and teamwork, even in high-level roles, acting as an individual with humility to progress, maintain the startup spirit.
  • Execution-driven – plans strategically but delivers tactically, for planning, guiding execution, and identifying new features, prospects, or improvements.
  • Energetic & Solution-Oriented – understanding the “why” to drive toward meaningful outcomes with positive energy, urgency, and a resolute mindset to ensure timely and effective responses. Strategic Communicator – Communicates clearly and persuasively, involving and engaging with different levels within companies, from clients, prospects, and collaborating with peers and colleagues.
  • Curious and resourceful – seeks to understand, improve, and innovate, as a Start-up needs to be innovative and not just follow.

We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our institutional page The Team
As Nubank continues its global expansion and continues innovating, the internal controls landscape becomes increasingly complex. Nubank has developed a strong Risk structure across the 1st and 2nd line of Defense but it is important to continue reinforcing the principles across the company and ensure that our 1st line teams continue to be accountable and responsible for the risks taken.
On that basis, the Business Control Office team is continuing to grow by adding one more area of focus and hiring someone to help us elevate our compliance management within the 1st line of Defense .
About The Role
Regulatory compliance is a complex and a critical component of proper risk management which requires very specific expertise. The initial person joining as the head of 1st line Compliance would help us drive the regulatory agenda in the 1st line with clear accountability and responsibility, and start supporting prioritized teams who are facing regulatory challenges.
It´s an IC position in the beginning with a global scope, with the opportunity to become a manager if the person has the ability to demonstrate how a team could help Nubank become more efficient and compliant with an increased level of support.
Key Responsabilities And Expectations

  • Understanding applicable regulations, and explaining/translating the need to the business according to the BU realities
    • Reading regulations and understanding their implications for the business, making sure requirements are fully mapped through the existing regulatory tracking process
    • Provide assessment to the 1st line through the discovery of regulatory requirements
    • Help the 1LoD to co-create and finalize e2e action plans to be compliant with applicable regulatory requirements, supporting Compliance 2LoD in the monitoring of the implementation of the requirements for new products/features and other regulatory requirements (e.g. 4966)
    • Aligning possible dependencies with other BUs and helping with prioritizations exercise of different bets.
  • Coordinate and support on responses and data shared with regulators (BACEN, CVM, Banxico, SFC, etc) and external/internal auditors on relevant subjects, for both reactive and proactive interactions.
  • Support Compliance on the planning and coordination of inspection when they happen
  • Empowering product teams with the knowledge and tools they need making compliance a competitive advantage of the innovation process making it seamless under a targeted friction approach
  • Performing regulatory assessment proactively for NP&F including the creation and follow up of action plans ahead of Defense assessments
  • Create appropriate timely reports for the leadership team to understand the full spectrum of regulatory risks
What We're Looking For
  • Fluent in English

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check more information here.

Job Summary
The successful candidate will report to the Sr. Director, Legal – Litigation and work closely with the Litigation Team and key business stakeholders to provide high-quality legal advice, primarily in the areas of product liability litigation, complex commercial disputes, warranty matters, and class actions. The successful candidate must be a team player with a demonstrated history of working collaboratively and effectively with an experienced group of lawyers and paralegals. The successful candidate also will be expected to independently manage an active caseload, strategically direct outside counsel and consultants, and skillfully advise internal business colleagues. Meaningful experience in all aspects of complex product liability, warranty, and class action litigation is required. The ideal candidate also will possess strong leadership and managerial courage, emotional intelligence and maturity, an appropriate sense of urgency, and excellent business partnership and relationship-building skills. A passion for the outdoors and an aptitude or interest in mechanical/engineering problem-solving is also highly desired.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Efficiently manage portions of the company’s complex pre-litigation and litigation matters, including matters involving product liability, warranty, commercial, and class action cases and other litigated matters in a manner that reflects internal priorities and protects company interests.
  • Confidently communicate with internal business stakeholders regarding litigated matters, process improvements, and other matters.
  • Independently and effectively manage and oversee outside counsel.
  • Negotiate litigation settlements and represent Polaris at mediations and trials.
  • Lead and contribute to process-improvement projects in support of the Legal Department’s mission and initiatives.
  • Develop and provide training to corporate colleagues on a variety of legal issues.
  • Monitor, review, and resolve day-to-day legal and regulatory issues as they are assigned.
Skills & Knowledge
  • Juris Doctor from an accredited law school.
  • Licensed and in good standing to practice law in at least one U.S. state, with the ability to become licensed in Minnesota.
  • 6-10 years of significant litigation experience either in-house or at a law firm, in the areas of product liability, class actions, or complex commercial litigation.
  • Confident team player with attorney and non-attorney legal professionals and business partners. Ability to manage, mentor, and direct paralegals in a collaborative setting.
  • Strong negotiation and dispute resolution skills.
  • Managerial and leadership courage.
  • Emotional intelligence and maturity.
  • Assertive self-starter with excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and superior time-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide practical and strategic legal advice to senior business leaders.
  • Technical background and knowledge of highly regulated consumer products is preferred.
Working Conditions
  • Hybrid working model (in office/WFH). Onsite schedule based on business need.
  • Potential for remote based with travel to Polaris locations based on business need, dependent on candidate qualifications.
  • Up to 25% Travel

Individual salaries and positioning within the range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills, and geography. While individual pay could fall anywhere in the range based on these factors, it is not common to start at the high end or top of the range.

As the global leader in powersports, Polaris Inc. We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Head of Payment Product - LATAM

We are looking for a product leader to shape the future of Payment Methods in LATAM.

As Head of Payment Product for LATAM, you will own the strategy, vision, and execution for Adyen’s core payments products in one of our most dynamic and high-growth regions. You’ll be responsible for defining what great looks like for Payment Methods in the region, aligning teams behind that vision, and delivering measurable impact to our customers and the business.

You will build and develop a team of high-performing Product Managers, raise the bar for product thinking, and take full ownership of the regional product portfolio. You are accountable for simplifying the product landscape, driving performance and adoption, and delivering real value to customers. You think long term, move fast, and keep the customer at the center.

What you’ll do:

  • Strategic Product Management: Define and drive product strategy across LATAM for core acquiring, local payment methods, and platform enablers. Set a clear vision with focus on customer needs, regional requirements, and global scalability.
  • Team Leadership: Build and develop a team of high-performing product managers. Raise the bar on product thinking, execution, and accountability. Foster a culture of ownership, customer centricity, and measurable outcomes. Ensure the team aligns with Adyen’s strategic goals and supports regional and global objectives.
  • Product Simplification & Optimization: Streamline the regional product portfolio to reduce complexity, improve reliability, and accelerate adoption. Drive clarity on what we stop, start, and scale based on customer impact and business value.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with commercial, engineering, partnerships, and compliance teams to bring products to market, improve performance, and solve hard problems.

Who you are:

  • 10+ years in product management, with 5+ years leading PMs. You’ve built high-performing teams and shipped complex products.
  • Deep expertise in payments, including acquiring and local payment networks in LATAM.
  • You’ve built and scaled products across multiple markets.
  • You are customer-centric and data-driven, always anchored in impact.
  • You simplify complexity and communicate with clarity.
  • You take full ownership and operate autonomously.
  • Travel: Some international travel will be required.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our São Paulo office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

The way we work is guided by the eight principles of the Adyen Formula. Learn more here.

No one only manages a search bar or a small feature. At Adyen, you’ll see each solution through the entire lifecycle, from conception to implementation to iteration. If you’re ready to think about the entire solution, then Adyen is right for you.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (100% remote)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

At Tether, we are at the forefront of integrating artificial intelligence with brain-computer interface technologies. Our projects leverage deep learning, generative models, and representation learning to decode and interpret brain activity. With our foundation in both established and cutting-edge AI infrastructure, our mission is to bridge the gap between AI and neuroimaging, driving innovation that’s not only revolutionary but also accessible, transparent, and privacy-focused.

We are looking for a motivated and skilled machine learning engineer to join our dynamic Brain & AI team. This role focuses on developing AI models that enhance our understanding of neural mechanisms building encoding and decoding models and apply this knowledge to real-world applications such as brain computer interfaces. You will be instrumental in pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in AI and neuroscience, helping to solve some of the most complex and fascinating challenges in the field today.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and evaluate scalable deep learning algorithms that are central to our brain decoding initiatives.

  • Collaborate closely with data scientists to pioneer research in generative modeling and representation learning.

  • Identify bottlenecks in data processing pipelines and devise effective solutions, improving performance and reliability.

  • Maintain high standards of code quality, organization, and automatization across all projects.

  • Adapt machine learning and neural network algorithms to optimize performance in various computing environments, including distributed clusters and GPUs.

  • Write and revise papers, participate in conferences, communicate and disseminate results.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Physics, Math, Neuroscience or another quantitative field.

  • 3+ years of experience of working in industry or research.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, with experience in developing machine learning algorithms or infrastructure using Python and PyTorch.

  • Experience in deep learning techniques such as supervised, semi-supervised, self-supervised learning, and/or generative modeling.

  • Strong scientific background and ability to formulate and test novel hypotheses with proper experiments, draw conclusions and support claims.

  • Proficient in managing unstructured datasets with strong analytical skills.

  • Demonstrated project management and organizational skills.

  • Proven ability to support and collaborate with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD and research experience in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Physics, Math, Neuroscience or another quantitative field.

  • Scientific publications in top-tier AI and neuroscience conferences (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, AAAI, CVPR, Cosyne, SFN, CNN ecc) or peer reviewed journals

  • Familiarity with deep learning libraries such as Pytorch, Huggingface, Transformers, Accelerator and Diffuser.

  • Hands-on experience in training and fine-tuning generative models like diffusion models or large language models such as GPTs and LLAMAs.

  • Experience with data and model visualization tools.

  • Experience with non-invasive neural data (fMRI, EEG, MEG) or invasive neural recordings (ECoG, MEA, ecc).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or@ tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Nós somos a TIMAC Agro Brasil: maior parceiro tecnológico do produtor que ousa desafiar os limites da produtividade.

title: Senior Manager Product Designer (Web)
description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Sr. Manager Product Designer Web in our Marketing Operations area in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Sr. Manager Product Designer Web is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the efforts of a team of web designers to ensure high-quality, strategically aligned design outcomes. As a leader, this role is accountable for setting design priorities, distributing tasks based on the skills and expertise within the team, optimizing existing design systems and processes for scalability, and contributing directly to practical design tasks when necessary. The Sr. Manager Product Designer Web also collaborates with cross-functional teams to establish design strategies that enhance user experience across multiple digital channels, including web and mobile platforms.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Build design process, delivering high-quality product interfaces while also maintaining and evolving design systems to ensure scalability and consistency across platforms.
  • Provide direct supervision to the team, offering guidance and support for their performance and development while ensuring alignment with company objectives.
  • Build the team - recruit, hire, and train new team members to ensure the team is staffed to full capacity.
  • Lead, mentor, and coordinate the efforts of a team of designers by delegating tasks according to skill sets and project demands.
  • Participate in leadership discussions to interpret and apply business strategy to design efforts, optimizing designs across channels (web and mobile).
  • Oversee and enhance the component library, particularly for scalability and mobile adaptability, collaborating with the team on component documentation.
  • Engage in strategic prioritization meetings to align design efforts with overall business goals;
  • Ensure tasks in Figma are well-organized and documented for development handoff.
  • Facilitate regular syncs with development and other departments to refine workflows, maintain alignment on goals, and support cross-departmental understanding of design assets.
  • Continuously refine and optimize design processes to improve delivery quality and team efficiency.
  • Directly participate in design delivery when needed.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science or related disciplines.
  • Advanced skills in Figma.
  • Expertise in User Experience best practices, Design and Accessibility guidelines Comprehensive understanding of design for web, mobile, and responsive interfaces.
  • Strong background in user-centered design and an understanding customer journey mapping.
  • Previous hands-on experience in design roles, with a proven track record of delivering impactful design solutions.
  • Experience with design systems: creating, maintaining, and optimizing them for consistency and efficiency across multiple platforms and teams.
  • Experience working with metrics, analytics, and user feedback, using data-driven insights to refine design solutions and measure success.
  • Expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies for user insights.
  • Strong project management abilities to prioritize, organize, and delegate tasks within the design team effectively.
  • Fluent English is mandatory.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in design roles and Proficiency in English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Levantar e diagnosticar os processos de enfermagem da unidade incorporada, propondo plano de integração alinhado às diretrizes institucionais;
  • Padronizar protocolos assistenciais com apoio da equipe multidisciplinar, promovendo unificação de condutas e fluxos;

  • Dimensionar a equipe de enfermagem com base em critérios institucionais, analisando perfis e recursos existentes;
  • Levantar e conduzir o plano de treinamentos e integração técnica da equipe da nova unidade;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas sanitárias e regulatórias durante a transição da unidade;
  • Integrar a nova unidade às comissões e núcleos institucionais (ex: segurança do paciente, CIPA, farmácia clínica etc.);
  • Regularizar e atualizar registros profissionais da equipe junto ao COREN;
  • Monitorar e apresentar indicadores de desempenho da assistência da nova unidade;
  • Implantar processos de qualidade e responder a auditorias internas e externas durante a integração;
  • Atuar na gestão de pessoas: escalas, férias, desempenho e integração cultural da equipe;
  • Garantir a conservação patrimonial, boas práticas assistenciais e adequações físicas da nova unidade.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Graduação completa em Enfermagem com registro ativo no COREN;
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão Hospitalar, Gestão em Saúde, Qualidade ou áreas afins (desejável);
  • Experiência prévia em coordenação de enfermagem em ambientes hospitalares;
  • Vivência com processos de acreditação hospitalar (ONA, ISO, JCI) será um diferencial;
  • Domínio de SAE, protocolos assistenciais e legislação sanitária;
  • Conhecimento em dimensionamento de equipe, gestão de pessoas e indicadores assistenciais.
  • Liderança e influência técnica;
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em resultados;
  • Habilidade de gestão de mudança e integração cultural;
  • Comunicação assertiva e empática;
  • Organização, planejamento e proatividade;
  • Resiliência e adaptabilidade frente a contextos de transição;
  • Capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão.

title: Strategy Lead
description:
Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

dLocal is scaling across 40+ emerging markets. We need a true strategy athlete to join our Corporate Development & Strategy team who can help us answer the big questions: Where should we play? How do we win? How do pricing, product, and market mix translate into durable growth and returns? How do we quantify our strategy behind all of this? This role combines high-level corporate strategy with hands-on strategic finance & analytics. You will shape multi-year direction and lead deep-dive projects. If you like moving between whiteboard frameworks, messy data, financial models, and executive conversations in the same week, this is for you.


What will I be doing?
  • Build and continuously update dLocal’s 3–5 year strategic planIdentify secular trends in global payments, regulation, FX, and digital commerce and translate them into strategic options.
  • Pressure-test strategic narratives for the executive team, the Board, and investors.
  • Global Pricing Strategy Revamp: build frameworks, run data analyses, model scenarios, recommend changes, support rollout.
  • Market & segment prioritization frameworks (ROI, margin, scalability, regulatory friction).Cross-functional strategic workstreams that turn “vision” into decisions, metrics, and sequencing.
  • Build and maintain decision-grade financial models alongside Finance, linking volume, pricing, take rate, cost-to-serve, and margin outcomes.
  • Develop scenario and sensitivity tools for new geographies, product bets, or commercial structures.
  • Size TAM / SAM / SOM by country and vertical; tie to revenue and gross profit potential.
  • Support investor messaging with data-backed strategic insights (working with IR and finance).
  • Produce crisp strategy memos, board materials, and exec readouts.
  • Translate complex analytics into clear tradeoffs and recommendations.
  • Drive alignment across Finance, Product, Commercial, Legal/Reg, and regional leadership.
What skills do I need?
  • 3–6 years of experience across strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, in-house corporate strategy, strategic finance, or pricing/monetization strategy at a tech, payments, or fintech company.
  • Exceptional structured problem solving; can create frameworks from messy questions.
  • Advanced financial modeling skills (Excel or FP&A stack): scenario, sensitivity, unit economics, contribution margin, pricing waterfalls.
  • Ability to interrogate data quality, reconcile multiple sources, and get to “decision-grade” numbers.Writes and presents clearly to execs; builds persuasive decks and models that tell a story.
  • Can move stakeholders from debate to decision.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and global, fast-moving environments.
  • Payments, acquiring, or cross-border settlements experience is a plus.
  • Exposure to emerging markets payment landscapes is a plus.
  • Pricing strategy or revenue optimization project experience is a plus.
  • Fluent English required; Spanish a plus.

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

- Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!*

- Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.

- Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.

- Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.

- Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.

- Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.

- Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!

- dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!

*For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out ourwebpage ,Linkedin ,Instagram , andYoutube for more about dLocal!

Preferred Qualifications (nice to have)

Behavioral Skills

  • Strong leadership to inspire and guide teams to deliver outstanding results.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to think critically and challenge the status quo.

  • Resilience and composure under pressure.

This role involves collaborating with diverse teams, meticulously analyzing data, conducting rigorous tests, and ensuring adherence to quality standards. Responsibilities include participating in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and maintenance, with a focus on ensuring quality at every step.
Essential Functions:
Develop and implement comprehensive test plans and test cases for software applications, covering manual and automated - functional, performance, integration and security aspects.
Analyze requirements, design specifications, and user stories to ensure comprehensive test coverage.Define test data requirements and create test condition matrices.
Participate in test planning and strategy sessions, collaborating with stakeholders to define scope and objectives.
Develop and maintain reusable test frameworks, libraries, and components to streamline the test automation process.
Execute automated test cases, analyze test results, and generate comprehensive test reports.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.
Perform evergreening of automation artifacts and ensure integration with Focused Build for SAP projects.
Collaborate with developers and product managers to identify and resolve software defects and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality products.
Track and manage defects using tools like ADO, QTest, or similar platforms, participate in triage and root cause analysis of software defects to prevent recurrence and improve development processes.
Communicate testing progress, issues, and risks effectively to the team and stakeholders.
Provide support and mentorship to junior quality engineers on quality-related matters.
Maintain clear and concise documentation for all quality assurance activities.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of quality assurance processes and methodologies by staying up-to-date with industry best practices.
Provide support to other team members on quality-related matters and mentor junior quality engineers.
Maintain clear and concise documentation for all quality assurance activities.
Participate in cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, design solutions, and ensure that quality standards are met throughout the software development lifecycle."
Qualifications
Typically a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 5-7 years of experience in software quality assurance. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and quality assurance methodologies.
Proficiency in software testing techniques, including functional testing, performance testing, and security testing.
Experience with test automation tools and frameworks.
Knowledge of software development processes, such as Agile and Waterfall.
Extensive experience (5+ years) in modern test tools like Tricentis Tosca, encompassing Test case design and development, effective utilization of reusable test modules, tosca automation architecture and infrastructure setup, distributed execution, TDS etc., along with knowledge about automation project set up using Tosca Server and Tosca Commander.
Proven experience designing and implementing scalable test automation frameworks using Tosca and potentially other tools. Understanding of different automation patterns and best practices.
Good C# programming skills to develop custom Tosca extensions and integrations is desirable.
Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and best practices. Experience defining testing strategies and ensuring comprehensive test coverage.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and experience working within Agile teams.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including developers, QA, and product owners.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Join to apply for the Business Development Executive role at Kistler O'Brien Fire Protection

Are you looking for a career in a fast paced, growing business with lots of opportunity for advancement? If so, then Encore Fire Protection may be the place for you. Encore is redefining the fire protection industry by taking a customer-first approach to everything we do.
As part of Encore's mission to be the best fire protection company the industry has ever seen, we have joined forces with Kistler O'Brien Fire Protection , headquartered in Bethlehem, PA. This partnership not only allows us to expand our footprint and find top talent in the North East PA, it also allows us to work with industry leaders who strive for the same level of excellence as we do.
At Encore, Business Development Executives are the impact players on our team. They are experienced sales professionals, with a well established network, and a drive to be successful no matter what. Another title for these high-income producers are "hunters." They aren't waiting for leads to come to them, they go out and get them! They are not deterred by initial rejection because they are skilled at over-coming objections. To join the ranks of our Business Development Team you must be ready and able to hit the ground running by developing and executing to a defined plan for success.
Questioning whether you're up for the challenge? Then this may not be the job for you. The top performing Business Development Executives don't shy away from a challenge; they charge it head on...mostly to prove (to themselves) they can succeed. And if that sounds like you, then there is definitely a place for you at the top of our sales charts!
A Day In The Life

  • Master the ability to deliver our value-proposition in person, over the phone, and in writing
  • Work with prospects and clients to identify needs, budgets, time-lines, business benefits, and key decision makers
  • Develop and maintain relationships with key decision makers, influencers and other industry contacts
  • Act as our primary point person for prospective project opportunities from internal and external sources
  • Accurately forecast and achieve sales goals
  • Learn and be passionate about the technical aspects of how our systems work to keep people safe
  • Prepare proposals, arrange product demonstrations, deliver presentations, competitively price services, negotiate contract terms, close deals, and oversee the hand-off from sales to operations
  • Maintain an organized and disciplined CRM usage to optimize success
Requirements
As an experienced sales professional, our expectation is that you will bring with you the following:
  • No less than 3-years professional sales experience in a relevant industry (be prepared to present year over year results in terms of volume and margin)
  • Zero inhibitions towards generating outbound prospecting efforts whether that be through cold calling, networking, asking for referrals, or by any other means necessary
  • Commitment to accurately documenting all prospecting interactions (calls, emails, meetings, etc.) using a web-based CRM platform
  • A defined and organized process for managing a schedule of follow-up
  • The ability to project and meet weekly sales goals
  • Discipline to work independently with minimal supervision, mange time effectively, and meet goals and deadlines
  • A high-level of proficiency with Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and a general proficiency with technology
Benefits
As a company, Encore is hyper-focused on developing a culture that thrives on success and is energized by the fact that we get to make peoples' lives better and safer each day. One of the ways we do this is by generously rewarding all those who contribute to our continued growth. But we also believe that not all rewards are monetary. Here are just a few a few perks that a successful individual in this role can expect:
  • Salary commensurate with experience with opportunity for a results-driven bonus based on personal output and effectiveness in role. Expected salary range between $70,000 - $90,000
  • No matter how you found us, we’re all about growth—yours and ours. While we’re required to post salary ranges (because transparency matters), we strongly encourage you to apply even if your expectations don’t line up exactly with the numbers. We’re a fast-evolving company with roles, projects, and opportunities that often go beyond what’s listed online. If you’re excited about the work we’re doing and the culture we have, we’d love to hear from you.
  • Purpose and results driven work environment (work smarter not harder)
  • We dress for the objective which means most days we wear jeans but occasionally we wear suits. As long as you know which situations require which (or aren't afraid to ask), you'll be all set!
  • Speaking of attire, we offer all employees Encore gear when they join the team
  • Freedom to express ideas - a culture of willingness to test, try, modify, adopt, enhance, improve and CHANGE as needed
  • Access to leading edge web-based productivity tools
  • Participation in 401(K) that includes employer match
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • Company-paid life insurance policy of $50,000

description:
Welcome to Infraspeak.

Our mission is simple: to transform facilities management with a collaborative platform that unifies every part of FM operations into one cohesive system — enabling every stakeholder to Work as One .

We go beyond traditional tools, eliminating fragmented systems in complex operations. Our platform ensures end-to-end collaboration across FM teams, processes and assets — with no silos, blind spots or overload.

Born in Porto , Portugal, we’re now a global company serving customers in 30+ countries and backed by top investors. But we’re just getting started .

  • We believe in ownership, collaboration, and meritocracy.

  • We believe that only great teams build great products — and that includes our customers.

  • We believe happiness is in the journey, not just the destination.

Above all, we are guided by our purpose: to Be a Source of a Good Life — for our customers, our team, and the broader community.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for an ambitious and high-performing Business Development Representative to help us keep and iterate a scalable outbound sales strategy, and acquire new customers in the LATAM market.
As the first person to interact with our outbound leads, you’ll need to make an amazing first impression and gain a deep understanding of their challenges.
The ideal candidate has prior outbound sales development experience and is comfortable with maintaining insightful conversations either by phone or email.

What will you do?

  • Source and prospect leads to feed our sales pipeline.
  • Prospecting into midmarket accounts, social selling, and account mapping.
  • Execute outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn cadences every day.
  • Work closely the market Account Executives.
  • Build trust in every interaction with prospects.
  • Identify prospects’ challenges and pain points.
  • Learn each prospect's decision-making process.
  • Nurture prospects all the way from the first email or engagement call to a discovery session.
  • Keep your pipeline and your data organized.
  • Use our CRM and other sales development tools as a Ninja.

What do we expect from you?

  • Demonstrable experience in outbound business development is a must – within a Tech/SaaS environment.
  • Charisma, ambition, resilience, and strong communication skills.
  • Know your data to hit your numbers.
  • Avid learner: constantly acquire new skills and don’t be afraid of trying something new.
  • Good English level (mandatory).
  • Be organized and productive.
  • Be a team member.

What do we offer?

  • Flexible working hours and remote-friendly culture.
  • Competitive salary and perks.
  • A startup environment, where you will see the company (and yourself) grow beyond a dozen people to a worldwide reference in the field (some people call it ambition, we call it focus).
  • A balanced work environment where you will have autonomy, responsibility, ownership, and freedom to make mistakes and to learn from them.
  • Regular events to promote knowledge sharingandteam engagement.

At Infraspeak, everyone is equal, unique, and valued. We believe diversity makes us stronger — shaping our culture, our business, and the world around us for the better — and we're committed to ethical talent acquisition, grounded in respect, fairness, and equal opportunity.
Our code of conduct is clear: discrimination has no place here — whether based on age, disability, gender, race, religion or belief, civil or parental status, political views, or any other basis protected by law.
"To be a source of a good life" isn't just a statement — it's our mission, and everyone is welcome to join us on that journey.

description:
Esteticista Massoterapeuta - Recife Espinheiro | PE

Além de realizar a aplicação de protocolos de estética e bem-estar, os profissionais técnicos do Buddha Spa são responsáveis por proporcionar uma experiência de bem-estar completa, atuando em todos os aspectos do atendimento e experiência do cliente dentro da cabine.

Ao ingressar na rede Buddha Spa, o profissional passa por um processo de imersão, treinamento e preparação para atuar de acordo com o padrão de excelência da marca.

Horário de trabalho: O profissional atua em média 7 horas por dia, com uma folga fixa durante a semana e um sábado de folga fixo. Aos domingos, o trabalho é por escala, geralmente dois domingos por mês.

Contratação: Contrato de parceria via Lei do Salão Parceiro (Lei 13.352/2016). É necessário abrir um MEI/CNPJ.

Remuneração: Repartição de resultados dos atendimentos, com porcentagem sobre os procedimentos realizados.

Plano de crescimento e benefícios: Incentivos e benefícios variam conforme o tempo de parceria e crescimento na escala de desenvolvimento:

  • Bronze – 20%
  • Prata – 25%
  • Ouro – 30%
  • Diamante – 35%

O Buddha Spa é a maior rede de Spas Urbanos do país, com unidades em diversas cidades e locais, buscando sempre proximidade com os clientes, em imóveis de rua, hotéis, condomínios, shoppings, salões e academias.

Focamos em serviços de bem-estar, relaxamento e estética, oferecendo mais de 25 terapias, incluindo massagens, banhos, tratamentos avançados, Day Spas, além de procedimentos específicos para público masculino, gestantes e pós-parto.

A essência do Buddha Spa está no valor do "sentir-se bem" em todos os aspectos. Nosso objetivo é proporcionar uma experiência única, despertando os cinco sentidos, com infraestrutura de alto padrão, sons, aromas e chás que complementam o toque profissional de nossos terapeutas.

Sophos is a global leader and innovator of advanced security solutions for defeating cyberattacks. Sophos is now the largest pure-play Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider, supporting more than 28,000 organizations. Descrição da vaga
Junta-se a nós e venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no Brasil. ️
A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções .
Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959, em Dubai. Possuímos mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países, nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes pelo mundo.
Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Brasilia (BSB)!
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Possuímos várias posições disponíveis com foco operacional, as principais sendo:

  • Auxiliar de Rampa
As atividades consistem na movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se telefone e rádio de comunicação. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco, esforço físico e deambulação por toda área operacional.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos, percepção auditiva para identificação de sinais sonoros de equipamentos e máquinas na pista.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
  • Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais (Limpeza)
As atividades consistem na organização da bolsa de suprimentos, aguardo da liberação de limpeza pela tripulação, acoplamento da escada na aeronave, coleta dos sacos de lixos, reposição dos suprimentos, aspiração do carpete, verificação da presença de objetos e higienização das poltronas e de bolsões, preenchimento de documentação do voo e limpeza das salas administrativas. Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
  • Auxiliar Administrativo (Operações)
As atividades consistem na gestão do faturamento e conciliação documental diária dos voos realizados, encaminhamento para departamento financeiro, elaboração de relatórios, lançamento de dados no sistema, arquivo, leitura e envio de e-mail. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se cadeira, mesa, arquivos, microcomputador, impressora com 1,28m de altura do piso e telefone. O setor encontra-se no piso térreo, com deslocamento do colaborador pelas áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto por meio de elevadores e escadas rolantes.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para elaboração de relatórios, leitura e elaboração de e-mails, faturamento, lançamento de dados no sistema, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores, visitantes e clientes.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

  • Vontade de trabalhar em equipe;
